description: This file defines a custom exception class 'EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException' used in the eShopOnWeb application, specifically within the ApplicationCore layer. The exception is thrown when attempting to checkout with an empty basket.

classes.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating that the shopping basket is empty during checkout.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException()
methods.description: Default constructor that sets a default message indicating that the basket cannot be empty during checkout.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(System.Runtime.Serialization.SerializationInfo info, System.Runtime.Serialization.StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Serialization constructor used during deserialization of the exception object.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor allowing custom message and inner exception for exception chaining.
